theme_strategy.rationale: Warm gold on soft ivory boutique aesthetic requested by the client. Fine jewellery shopping relies on warm, natural lighting, pristine metal reflections, and high-trust tactile luxury. Light warm ivory canvas with rich champagne gold and deep obsidian-bronze gives a high-end atelier feel.

typography.notes_on_century_gothic_alternative: Century Gothic is a geometric circular sans with tall x-height and generous round bowls. Outfit Variable is the closest match from the pre-bundled font manifest, delivering that modern circular geometric luxury silhouette paired with Plus Jakarta Sans for body legibility.

grids_and_layouts.header_nav: Sticky glass navbar (backdrop-blur-md bg-stone-50/95 border-b border-stone-200/80 px-4 sm:px-8 py-3.5) with Veeraa logo in Outfit Variable, Category Dropdown / direct links (Earrings, Chains, Rings, Bracelets), Track Order & Exchange tabs, Search, WhatsApp direct connect, Cart Drawer button with item badge, and Profile/Admin menu.
grids_and_layouts.hero_section: Asymmetric 12-column grid: 7 cols left (Heritage tag, headline 'Everyday Luxury Crafted to Last', feature trio pills 'Waterproof · Sweatproof · 18k Gold & 925 Silver', Shop Collection CTA, WhatsApp Concierge CTA), 5 cols right (Hero portrait in rounded-3xl container with floating 'Anti-Tarnish 365 Days Guaranteed' gold pill).
grids_and_layouts.just_arrived_section: Bento showcase: Large spotlight item (col-span-12 md:col-span-5) with big imagery and detailed attributes + 4-grid items (col-span-12 md:col-span-7 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4). Each card features metal badge (18k Gold Plated / 925 Sterling Silver), Sweatproof & Daily Wear tags, INR price with strikethrough, Quick Add to Cart, WhatsApp Enquiry trigger, and fast preview modal.
grids_and_layouts.category_tiles_grid: 4-column responsive grid (grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6) with smooth zoom on hover, subtle gold border on active card, showing piece count and starting price in INR (e.g. 'From ₹899').
grids_and_layouts.product_feature_explainer: 3-column interactive feature matrix: 'Sweat Proof & Waterproof' (how PVD gold coating protects through workouts & showers), 'Daily Wear Durability' (hypoallergenic base metals, zero nickel), 'Atelier Craftsmanship' (hand-polished 925 silver & 18k gold tone).
grids_and_layouts.homepage_utility_tabs: Seamless Tabbed Section on Homepage with smooth tab switching: Tab 1 'Track Your Order' (Instant live order lookup by Order ID or phone with step-by-step progress tracker); Tab 2 'Exchange & Return Policy' (7-day hassle-free doorstep exchange request form + policy highlights); Tab 3 'Customer Feedback & Love' (Interactive Star Rating + feedback submission that saves straight to MongoDB and streams directly into Admin Dashboard).
grids_and_layouts.product_detail_page: Split layout: Left 6-col high-res image zoom gallery with thumbnail switcher; Right 6-col sticky purchase module with metal selector (18K Gold Plated / 925 Silver), ring/chain size selector with size guide modal, 'Sweat Proof & Daily Wear' badge stack, live stock indicator, Pincode delivery estimator, WhatsApp 1-click enquiry with pre-filled product name, Razorpay-style instant buy & Add to Bag buttons, collapsible accordion (Care Guide, Material & Specs, Delivery & Returns).
grids_and_layouts.cart_and_checkout: Slide-out Cart Sheet + Full Checkout Page with Razorpay test simulator (Card, UPI / GPay / PhonePe, Netbanking, Cash on Delivery with verification), coupon code apply ('VEERAA10'), order summary with shipping breakdown in INR (₹), and customer address capture.
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: Comprehensive tabbed Admin Suite (accessible with credentials or demo switch): 1. Products Manager (Add/Edit/Delete products, toggle Sweat Proof, Daily Wear, Stock, Category, Image URL, Price, Metal Type); 2. All Orders & Purchase History (View customer name, items, order status dropdown 'Processing', 'Shipped', 'Out for Delivery', 'Delivered', payment mode, invoice generator); 3. Customer Feedbacks Box (View all submitted ratings, testimonials, approve for website display, sentiment tags, reply note).

motion.accessibility_motion: prefers-reduced-motion respected via standard tailwind motion-safe classes

accessibility.contrast_guarantee: All text colors achieve at least 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast against their respective parent surface. Dark warm text #1C1917 and #57534E on #FAF7F2 page and #FFFFFF panels reach > 7:1 contrast.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44px by 44px clickable areas for all buttons, inputs, and drawer handles.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, WhatsApp links, checkout buttons, admin action controls) have semantic data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent.tagline: Modern Gold Plated & 925 Silver Jewellery · Crafted for Everyday Brilliance
instructions_to_main_agent.font_setup: Import Outfit Variable and Plus Jakarta Sans Variable in frontend/src/index.css. Use --font-heading: 'Outfit Variable', sans-serif and --font-sans: 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif.
instructions_to_main_agent.whatsapp_integration: Generate direct WhatsApp link on product detail and cart (e.g., https://wa.me/919876543210?text=Hello%20Veeraa,%20I%20am%20interested%20in%20...) with prefilled product title, price, and SKU.
instructions_to_main_agent.key_product_attributes: Every product item must clearly display: 1. Metal Type (18k Gold Plated or 925 Sterling Silver), 2. 'Sweat Proof' boolean + badge, 3. 'Daily Wear' boolean + badge, 4. Anti-Tarnish warranty, 5. Price in ₹ with original price and discount badge.
instructions_to_main_agent.homepage_tabs_requirement: Homepage must include the interactive 'Track Your Order', 'Exchange & Returns', and 'Feedback Box' tabs with working mock and live API submission.
instructions_to_main_agent.admin_and_customer_auth: Provide seamless login/signup with role toggle (Customer vs Admin) with pre-filled test credentials for instant evaluation (e.g. admin@veeraa.com / admin123; customer@veeraa.com / customer123) and ability to manage products, purchase histories, and customer feedback.
instructions_to_main_agent.seed_data_recommendation: Seed at least 12 exquisite jewellery items across all 4 categories (Earrings, Chains/Necklaces, Rings, Bracelets) with realistic high-resolution images, INR pricing, sweatproof/dailywear tags, and at least 4 seeded orders and 4 customer feedbacks.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark color gradients. Use clean warm solid surfaces with subtle 1px border highlights.
Every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, status toggles) MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes for automated testing.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Use editorial asymmetric grids and bento card hierarchies.
Ensure all forms use Shadcn base components with explicit labels, error states, and responsive padding.
Use Sonner for toasts placed at bottom-right.
Ensure the header is sticky with crystal glass styling (backdrop-blur-md bg-stone-50/95) so nav links remain crisp and legible at all times.
All prices should be formatted in Indian Rupee format (₹) with comma separation (e.g., ₹1,299).
